jobs.title: Customer Success Analyst
jobs.description:
Join TRG Screen: Building World-Class Teams. One Expert at a Time.

Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team at the forefront of subscription spend management innovation?

At TRG Screen, we're not just redefining how organizations manage their subscription expenses – we're shaping the future of the industry. With cutting-edge solutions and a commitment to excellence, we empower businesses around the globe to optimize their subscription investments and drive sustainable growth.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize subscription management and make a meaningful impact on the way businesses access and utilize critical information. At TRG Screen, your talent and ambition will find a home, where opportunities for growth and advancement abound.

About TRG Screen

TRG Screen is the leading provider of market data and subscription management technology and automation solutions, tailored to the unique needs of financial institutions and legal firms. Our integrated suite of solutions includes market data and subscription spend management, usage management, compliance reporting, and comprehensive managed services, which hundreds of clients worldwide use to remove cumbersome and inaccurate manual processes and gain control over market data and subscription costs at scale. For more than 25 years, TRG Screen has enabled businesses who rely on market data to monitor and strategically manage spending and usage of data and information services, including market data, research, software licenses, consulting and other necessary corporate expenses. TRG Screen solutions give decisionmakers full transparency into subscription spend and usage, enabling them to proactively manage subscription costs at scale, conduct more informed vendor negotiations, improve governance, and avoid unnecessary spending on these mission-critical business services. TRG Screen is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Europe and Asia, as well as a 24x7 client support center in Bangalore, India.

TRG Screen is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s largest and most respected private equity firms.

Customer Success Analyst

Note: This role supports US-based clients and requires candidates to work US hours on a rotating schedule. Specific hours and rotation details will be discussed during the interview process.*

Role Overview

As a Customer Success Analyst, you will work directly with customers to ensure they have realized maximum value from our platform. Working in partnership with Customer Care, Sales, Professional Services, and Managed Services teams, you will help our customers achieve business goals and program impact while driving retention and growth for TRG Screen.

You will be responsible for delivering an optimal customer experience, fostering positive customer outcomes, delivering proactive recommendations, and driving ongoing business impact. This role is ideal for candidates with customer-facing experience, analytics/data operations backgrounds, or strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

You may support both Financial segment customers (banks, asset managers, hedge funds, and other enterprise financial institutions) and Legal segment customers (law firms and legal services organizations), managing market data workflows, compliance requirements, data operations, and operational efficiency. You will amplify the voice of the customer internally by driving continuous feedback into cross-functional teams on ways we can better serve our customers.

Note: This role supports US-based clients and requires candidates to work US hours on a rotating schedule. Specific hours and rotation details will be discussed during the interview process.*

MISSION

Our mission is to help customers realize the full value of their TRG Screen investment by turning complex operational challenges into efficient, compliant, and scalable solutions. We partner with customers to reduce friction, improve visibility and adoption, and deliver measurable business value and ROI.

For our customers across both segments, this means helping transform manual, error-prone processes into streamlined, auditable systems that reduce risk, improve efficiency, and empower teams to focus on work that matters most.

Customer Success Analysts develop a deep understanding of customer goals, identifying innovative solutions which align to desired platform outcomes. You will partner with customers to value realization to ensure customers are achieving their identified business outcomes.

When Our Customers Realize Success, TRG Realizes Success Via High Customer Satisfaction, Growth, And Retention. Key Areas Of Emphasis And Success Indicators For Our CS Analysts Include

Retention: Retain recurring revenue in customer portfolio while actively monitoring usage and compliance health to identify at-risk accounts early
Positive Customer Experience: Build customer usage, adoption, and perceived ROI by delivering an optimized customer experience and proving value throughout the customer journey—with particular emphasis on operational efficiency and regulatory compliance
Account Health & Risk Management: Monitor usage patterns, data quality, and contract compliance within customer portfolios. Proactively identify at-risk customers and execute on heal plays to retain the customer and improve overall account health. Drive expansion through upselling of adjacent workflows, not just feature adoption.
*Note: This role supports US-based clients and requires candidates to work US hours on a rotating schedule. Specific hours and rotation details will be discussed during the interview process.*

Required Skills & Capabilities

Proven track-record of helping customers drive sustained product adoption, customer satisfaction, and overall customer health
Effective at establishing credibility and influencing executive and operational leadership within large enterprise organizations
Skilled relationship builder who can develop trusted, multi-level relationships across key stakeholders (IT, operations, procurement, technical) within customer organizations
Proven ability to proactively nurture customer accounts to identify revenue expansion opportunities and ensure successful renewals
Understanding of the customer journey and experience serving as a strategic advisor in translating customers' goals into outcomes through ownership and execution of a customer success plan
Ability to prioritize accounts to focus efforts based on perceived risk, potential growth, strategic value, and renewal timeframe
Well-versed in communicating value and guiding customers to achieve their defined business objectives
Ability to translate product functionality into business impact—comfortable discussing data lineage, accuracy, analytical validation and reporting with both technical and business stakeholders
Can empathize with customers and stakeholders at all levels, with an ability to convert empathy into advocacy
Ability to solve complex challenges independently and confidently
Extensive experience leading effective and consistent customer Business Reviews based on defined rubric
Strong written and verbal communication skills
*Note: This role supports US-based clients and requires candidates to work US hours on a rotating schedule. Specific hours and rotation details will be discussed during the interview process.*

TECHNICAL FLUENCY

Comfortable reviewing data and usage reports and explaining findings to customers
Familiarity with AI-assisted tools (e.g., for account insights, meeting intelligence, or workflow automation) and comfort utilizing these tools in a daily workflow

BACKGROUND & EXPERIENCE (Preferred)

Background in mathematics, analytics, science, data operations, or related analytical fields preferred
Experience working within complex, highly regulated markets
Previous experience using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)

CHARACTERISTICS THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL POSSESS

Curiosity
Bias for action
Resiliency
Strong time management skills
Comfort with ambiguity in data-driven problem solving
Strong analytical and quantitative thinking skills
Comfortable adopting AI-assisted tools to increase productivity and focus more time on strategic customer conversations. We expect CSMs to integrate these tools into daily workflows.
Travel 25% annually for strategic customer meetings and team offsites
*Note: This role supports US-based clients and requires candidates to work US hours on a rotating schedule. Specific hours and rotation details will be discussed during the interview process.*

About The Customer Success Team

We're responsible for ensuring that clients have an amazing experience with TRG Screen. We are dedicated to every user's success and address challenges quickly and creatively.

We act as staunch advocates for our clients, including identifying and responding to diverse client use cases. We take pride in developing personal relationships with our users and our team.

We regularly support one another to ensure the success of our team and our clients. Our CSMs work across multiple segments and understand that our work directly impacts operational efficiency, compliance, and decision-making for some of the world's largest enterprises.

Join TRG Screen and unlock your potential in an environment where innovation thrives, opportunities abound, and your contributions make a difference. We are an equal opportunities employer. We recognise and value the power of diversity in our workplace and are committed to being an employer of choice for everyone. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds. All applications for employment are considered strictly on the basis of merit.

At TRG Screen, we understand that diverse and inclusive teams are not just beneficial, they are essential to our success. We recognize that embracing diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fosters innovation, enhances problem-solving capabilities, and drives better business outcomes. By cultivating a culture of inclusion where every voice is heard and valued, we empower our world class teams to thrive, excel, and drive positive change.

We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.

We encourage all applicants to review our Privacy Policy to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal data throughout the recruitment process. Our Privacy Policy is available at: www.trgscreen.com/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Geospatial Analyst I
jobs.description:
The Enviva team is driven by our shared vision for a renewable energy future. We are a fast-growing, purpose-driven, global energy company specializing in delivering sustainable wood bioenergy solutions. We are the world’s largest producer of sustainable wood pellets, which provide a low-carbon alternative to fossil fuels.

Introduction

The Enviva team is driven by our shared vision for a renewable energy future. We are a fast-growing, purpose-driven, global energy company specializing in delivering sustainable wood bioenergy solutions. We are the world's largest producer of sustainable wood pellets, providing biogenic carbon solutions for power and heat generation, industrial processes, chemicals, and advanced biofuels worldwide.

Job Purpose

Enviva seeks a motivated and detail-oriented Geospatial Analyst I to join its Sustainability team. Reporting to the Lead Geospatial Specialist, this role will support the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of geospatial data used in forestry operations, supplier traceability, sustainability reporting, and field-to-office workflows.

The position will initially focus on data editing, quality assurance, established workflow execution, and operational GIS support. The successful candidate will be expected to identify recurring data problems, recognize opportunities to replace manual efforts with automation, and suggest practical workflow improvements.

This is an early-career position for someone with a strong GIS foundation who wants to develop their experience in geospatial data management, automation, remote-sensing outputs, and interactive reporting in a fast-moving, innovative department.

Responsibilities

Review geospatial and tabular data for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and adherence to established standards.
Identify, document, and communicate geometry, attribute, identifier, relationship, attachment, and data-model issues via spatial hosted feature services. This will commence with data corrections for review, progressing into assumed responsibility for data quality assurance.
Understand, run, and examine results of established geoprocessing tools, scripts, SQL queries, data updates, and QA/QC checks.
Maintain authoritative tract, stand, supplier, and related operational datasets.
Investigate GIS application and workflow issues, with ability to distinguish incorrect source data, user error, and system flaws.
Provide first-line support for Field Maps and other operational GIS applications, escalating issues when appropriate.
Support supplier-data intake, standardization, validation, and loading into established GIS datasets.
Work with the Sustainability Analyst and operational teams to document, assign, track, and resolve identified data issues.
Support development and maintenance of geospatial error-flagging system for managing discrepancies, corrections, and recurring data-quality trends.
Support changes to field-to-office workflows and help implement attribute rules, validation processes, and data-enrichment methods.
Produce standalone maps and GIS data deliverables upon request.
Identify repetitive manual processes and recommend opportunities for improved efficiency, consistency, or automation.
Document workflows, processing decisions, identified issues, and completed corrections.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in GIS, geography, forestry, natural resources, environmental science, civil engineering, information systems, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
Two to four years of relevant GIS experience.
Ability to independently edit data, run geoprocessing tools, perform basic spatial analysis, and produce maps in ArcGIS Pro.
Understanding of feature classes, tables, joins, relates, coordinate systems, coordinate geometry, and common geospatial data formats.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies in spatial and tabular data.
Ability to investigate routine GIS problems, document findings, and seek guidance when needed.
Strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications - What Will Set Them Apart

Experience in forestry, natural resources, utilities, civil engineering, conservation, or other field involving real-world spatial data.
Familiarity with forest-material operations, mobile data collection, or field-to-office workflows.
Experience with ArcGIS Online, hosted feature layers, web maps, Field Maps, GNSS survey equipment, photogrammetry, Survey123, or Dashboards.
Experience with SQL, ETL processes, schema mapping, or data validation.
Exposure to Python or another scripting language.
Familiarity with imagery, remote sensing, parcel data, or environmental datasets.

Working Conditions

This role follows a hybrid schedule. Four days of in-office work per week will be expected during the initial onboarding and integration period, transitioning to a hybrid schedule of 2–3 days in-office per week once sufficiently integrated into the role.

Physical Requirements

Primarily computer-based work requiring extended periods of sitting and/or standing at a computer and typing.
May also include standing, walking, carrying, or lifting (up to 50 lbs.) in support of team tasks.

Travel Requirements

10% or less

This position is not eligible for visa support.
